title: Loneliness to Connection
tagline: From chaos to calm: Unlock the science of lasting peace.
overview: What if the ache you’ve been carrying isn’t a flaw, but a signal? What if there’s a hidden roadmap—one that can shift the way you see yourself, others, and the bonds that shape your life? This journey will help you uncover something essential you’ve been missing, and show you how to transform it into your greatest strength.

title: Stress to Peace
tagline: From chaos to calm: Unlock the science of lasting peace.
overview: Do you ever feel like life is pressing down on you—your body tense, your mind racing, your heart never at rest? What if stress wasn’t something you just had to manage, but a signal pointing you toward something deeper? This journey offers a fresh way to understand what’s happening inside you and shows you how to uncover a lasting calm already within your reach.

title: Anger to Love
tagline: Transforming Anger into Love: A Journey of Emotional Mastery
overview: Do you feel anger arriving like a storm you never saw coming—loud, overwhelming, and impossible to control? This journey guides you from reacting to reconnecting by teaching you to read the signals beneath the rage, pause long enough to heal what’s driving it, and then intentionally cultivate the love that replaces it. No judgement, no quick fixes—just a practical, compassionate path to transform what once divided you into what now binds you.

title: Confusion to Clarity
tagline: Step out of the fog. Step into yourself.
overview: Ever feel like your thoughts are pulling you in circles—like you’re searching for answers but the harder you try, the foggier everything becomes? This journey is for those moments. It’s not about quick fixes or lofty theories—it’s about uncovering something deeper that keeps you stuck, and finding a way through that mist into something steadier, lighter, and surprisingly simple.

title: Distraction to Focus
tagline: From scattered to centered—discover the state you were meant to live in.
overview: Do you ever feel like life is moving faster than your ability to keep up, leaving you scattered and drained? Deep down, you know there’s a calmer, sharper, more centered version of you waiting to be uncovered. This journey will help you find it—not through hacks or quick fixes, but by reshaping the very way you move through life.

title: Gita In A Day
tagline: Discover Timeless Wisdom to Thrive in Life's Battles - Within  and Beyond
overview: 108 most practical teachings of Bhagavad Gita.

title: Habits
overview: Ever set a promise and watched it quietly fizzle by Tuesday? This little journey is the warm, no-shame map that helps you see what’s actually running the show. We’ll pull apart the tiny moments that create habits, try one simple experiment, and hand you practical moves that don’t require heroics—just a handful of tiny, smart changes you can actually keep. Bring one habit, a little curiosity, and a refusal to be harsh on yourself.
